snippet.title: First look at FIFA Rivals!
snippet.description:
FIFA Rivals is a new, fully licensed FIFA mobile game for iOS and Android from Mythical Games that blends arcade-style quick-play football with strategic team management. The game lets players buy, sell, and trade unique digital assets of real football players, iconic clubs, and memorable moments to build the ultimate dream team.

http://fifa.rivals.game
http://x.com/FIFARivals
